name: MORTUARY CHAMBER
desc: 2-Body Laboratory and Hospital Mortuary Cabinet engineered for highly reliable, low-temperature cadaver preservation. Features 2 independent SS304 body compartments driven by dedicated cooling systems for each chamber using CFC-free R-404A refrigerant.
features: 2 Body Compartments independent dual chamber layout
Individual dedicated refrigeration system for each separate chamber
High-Grade Corrosion-Proof Stainless Steel (SS304 Grade) inside and out
Integrated Data Logger and Temperature Chart Recorder system

specifications.Equipment Configuration: Heavy-Duty Hospital & Morgue Cadaver Preservation Mortuary Cabinet
specifications.Storage Capacity Profile: 2 Body Compartments independent dual chamber layout
specifications.Display Interface Panel: High-Visibility Digital LED Display with real-time parameter tracking
specifications.Thermal Tracking Tools: Integrated Analogue Temperature Gauge with digital data logging layout
specifications.Refrigeration System Design: Individual dedicated refrigeration system for each separate chamber
specifications.Compressor Integrity: Heavy-Duty Industrial ISI Marked Compressor assembly
specifications.Air Distribution Method: Motorized Forced Air Cooling system for rapid thermal equilibrium

specifications.Chamber Locking System: Individual standard secure key lock assembly for each chamber
specifications.Insulation Core Barrier: 50 mm to 100 mm thick High-Grade Polyurethane Foam (PUF)
specifications.Safety Integration Alarms: Built-in Audio and Visual Temperature Variation Alarm system
specifications.Internal Lighting System: Moisture-proof internal cabinet illumination lamps for human safety
